text.tspan: Army headquarters. The declaration of war is signed.
The city marches out to attack the bots.
They declared war on US? Fine.
We're the BAD bots. Time to show them.
The city fires the FIRST shot.

svg.text: CRIMEBOT: TIMEBOT’S DREAM • CHAPTER 2: THE WAR • PAGE 1 • BY THE S.I.P. • SINCE 2024
